content: It's now day 2, 16:88 — the plan ran through the day. The rock still blocks (11,4). We need to pass time until day 5 morning. I'll keep the body busy with a longer wait plus a bit of movement, then retry the corridor.

args.approach: Still day 2 and the rock at (11,4) blocks the only corridor; wiki says it clears on the morning of day 5. So wait out the days (long waits) with a short walk in between, then walk the east corridor north to the chest at (11,1).
